mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ranking_cache ( trip_id, ranking, score, temperature, weather, region ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{rankNo}, #{score}, #{temperature}, #{weather}, #{region} )
mapper.select: SELECT rc.ranking AS rankNo, rc.trip_id AS tripId, t.name AS title, t.image_url AS imageUrl, rc.score AS score, rc.temperature AS temperature, rc.weather AS weather, rc.region AS region FROM ranking_cache rc JOIN trip t ON rc.trip_id = t.trip_id ORDER BY rc.ranking ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT rc.ranking AS rankNo, rc.trip_id AS tripId, t.name AS title, t.image_url AS imageUrl, rc.score AS score, rc.temperature AS temperature, rc.weather AS weather, rc.region AS region FROM ranking_cache rc JOIN trip t ON rc.trip_id = t.trip_id WHERE rc.region = #{region} ORDER BY rc.ranking ASC LIMIT 5
